text:
Sam: FYI pushed a quick follow-up to PR #4231 that addresses the race in the allocator. PTAL when you get a sec.
Alex: thanks! will take a look in ~30
Sam: main changes: remove unsafe ref in kv_allocator, added a deterministic test. diff is small — two files. also added a short note in the PR body about rollback safety.
maria: quick q — did you have to change the public API? will this affect Dedicated customers?
Sam: no API change, just internal allocator behavior. Verified e2e on staging (loadtest + canary).
jen: can you paste the failing log you saw? curious if this overlaps with the other flake we saw last week
Sam: pasted log: ```
2026-03-15T14:12:08Z ERROR allocator: allocation mismatch on rotate id=0x7f3c... pid=2345
stack: runtime/alloc.go:412 rotate()
``` 
Alex: lgtm overall, left one tiny nit: rename var `tmp` -> `rotationBuf` and add a comment why we avoid memcpy. otherwise approve once CI green
Sam: thanks! pushed fixup for var rename + comment. kicked CI again: `./ci/run-smoke.sh`
ci-bot: CI queued for PR #4231 — smoke tests, unit, integration (estimated 18m)
maria: left one question inline about the test seed. if that stays stable, I'm good to approve
Sam: switched test seed to fixed value and re-ran — passed locally, pushed change
Alex: approving now :thumbsup:
maria: approving as well :+1:
Sam: OK merging to canary in the next slot (09:00 PST). will monitor throttles
jen: ping me when it's live, I'll sanity-check error rates
Sam: will do, leaving a note in #deploys when canary starts :eyes:
